scenarios.title: For Mirrodin! creates a Rebel token and attaches the Equipment to it

setup.notes: Vulshok Splitter is {3}{R} Equipment with For Mirrodin! and 'equipped creature gets +2/+0'. B has Counterspell {U}{U} and Shatter {1}{R} in hand and passes in the base case.

decisions: A casts Vulshok Splitter, tapping four Mountains. B passes; it resolves and enters.
The For Mirrodin! trigger goes on the stack. B passes; it resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: The trigger fires. A 2/2 red Rebel creature token is created and Vulshok Splitter is attached to it: the token is a 4/2.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Vulshok Splitter, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Vulshok Splitter is countered and moves to A's graveyard. It never enters, so no trigger fires and no token is created.

variants.label: destroyed_in_response
variants.delta: B casts Shatter on Vulshok Splitter in response to the For Mirrodin! trigger, tapping two Mountains.
variants.expected: Vulshok Splitter is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. The trigger still resolves and creates a 2/2 red Rebel token, which is not equipped, since the Equipment is no longer on the battlefield.
